ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels (~85-90%) with high-intensity white pixel clusters (~10-15%) localized at the lateral tips and scattered as circular rosettes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black fields covering the central and inner lobe areas; high-contrast white geometric blobs concentrated on the distal tips and along the superior trailing margin; scattered white circular pixel clusters (rosettes) across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the superior boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from shallow ripples to deep clefts approximately 20-30 pixels in depth relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep with a widening trajectory toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely scattered circular white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes, with higher spatial density on the outer third of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, horizontal and diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters (Balanidae) along the leading edge and extreme distal tips, creating jagged 3D structural irregularities.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy encrustation of living barnacles on the lateral-most edges of both lobes, distinct from the pigment-based markings.
